ITEM 1 | Crispy, flat, thin strips of cooked meat with reddish-brown browned edges and glossy rendered fat, several overlapping pieces arranged diagonally across the center-left of the plate, about 14 cm long and 1 cm thick, rigid and slightly curled | 60
ITEM 2 | Cubed roasted potatoes with golden-brown crisped outer surfaces and pale cream interiors, cut into irregular chunks about 2-3 cm across, clustered in the lower-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 3 | Cylindrical sausage pieces with smooth reddish-brown glossy casings and slightly darker caramelized spots, four to five pieces about 2.5 cm diameter and 3-4 cm long, scattered in the upper center and right of the plate | 120
ITEM 4 | Whole and halved fresh strawberries with bright red glossy flesh, white-tipped stem ends visible, moist surfaces, roughly 2-3 cm each, placed along the right side of the plate | 75
ITEM 5 | Small dark blueberries with smooth skins and slight bloom, about 1 cm each, scattered in a small cluster near the upper right | 10
ITEM 6 | Fresh spinach-like leaves in deep green with some darker veins and glossy wet sheen, arranged in a loose layer across the upper and right portion of the plate | 35
ITEM 7 | Shredded orange carrot matchsticks, thin and slightly moist, about 4-5 cm long, scattered over the greens on the right side | 8
ITEM 8 | Small pale-green pieces of cooked or raw vegetable with glossy surfaces and slightly wrinkled texture, clustered at the lower right edge near the greens | 25
